title: AgentBuilderAgent v1.2: code-level implementation of Human-Gated write (create_branch/create_pull_request) with ToolGate enforcement
summary:
Promotes the v1.2 limited-write design into code-level, function-granular implementation.

What this patch does (v1.2):
- Adds a concrete, testable write-execution flow inside AgentBuilderAgent (no more placeholder comments).
- Enforces Human Gate and ToolGate gating before any write tool call:
  - humanApproved must be true (external input)
  - ToolGate evaluate(tool, effect=write) must allow
  - deny => no-call and proposal continues
- Computes pathsTouched/filesTouchedCount from the proposal changes to pass into ToolGate context.
- Records ToolGate decisions and (if executed) write results into proposal.summary.
- Keeps v1.2 scope minimal: only create_branch + create_pull_request; NO merge/rebase/force-push.

Tests:
- Adds focused unit/integration-style tests for _maybe_execute_write:
  - Scenario 6: allow => write tools called
  - Scenario 7: humanApproved=false => deny/no-call
  - Scenario 8: filesTouchedCount > limit => deny/no-call
  - Scenario 9: highRiskDetected or high-risk path present => deny/no-call

Safety:
- This is a proposal-only patch; it introduces runtime capability but does not execute any git actions by itself.
- Default runtime wiring uses a disabled write-tools implementation unless explicitly configured.

notes: introduces optional write-capable code path (still ToolGate + human gated)
default wiring keeps write tools disabled unless configured

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WriteResult:
    ok: bool
    message: str
    ref: Optional[str] = None
    url: Optional[str] = None


class GitWriteTools:
    """Abstraction for limited git/PR write tools (v1.2).

    IMPORTANT:
    - Concrete implementations may call external systems.
    - This interface MUST remain limited in scope for v1.2.
    """

    async def create_branch(self, *, repo: str, base: str, branch: str) -> WriteResult:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def create_pull_request(
        self, *, repo: str, base: str, head: str, title: str, body: str
    ) -> WriteResult:
        raise NotImplementedError


class DisabledGitWriteTools(GitWriteTools):
    """Safe default: write tools are disabled unless explicitly wired."""

    async def create_branch(self, *, repo: str, base: str, branch: str) -> WriteResult:
        return WriteResult(ok=False, message="write tools disabled")

    async def create_pull_request(
        self, *, repo: str, base: str, head: str, title: str, body: str
    ) -> WriteResult:
        return WriteResult(ok=False, message="write tools disabled")

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable, Optional

from agents import Agent

from agent_builder_agent.core.errors import error_response
from agent_builder_agent.core.proposal_builder import build_pull_request_proposal
from agent_builder_agent.core.risk_detector import detect_high_risk
from agent_builder_agent.core.repo_reader import snapshot_from_existing_tree
from agent_builder_agent.core.diff_planner import derive_structure_hints
from agent_builder_agent.core.skeleton_generator import generate_skeleton as _generate_skeleton
from agent_builder_agent.core.skeleton_generator import infer_steps_if_missing as _infer_steps_if_missing
from agent_builder_agent.core.spec_parser import SpecParseError, normalize_spec as _normalize_spec, parse_spec as _parse_spec
from agent_builder_agent.core.validators import schema_validate_request_v0, schema_validate_proposal_v0
from agent_builder_agent.core.toolgate_client import ToolGateClient, ToolGateConfig, ToolGateError
from agent_builder_agent.core.github_facts import (
    GitHubFacts,
    format_github_facts_section,
    summarize_ci_failures,
    summarize_open_prs,
)
from agent_builder_agent.router.llm_router_client import LLMRouterClient, LLMRouterConfig, LLMRouterError
from agent_builder_agent.schemas.agent_builder_request_v0 import AgentBuilderRequestV0
from agent_builder_agent.tools.github_read_client import GitHubReadClient, GitHubReadConfig, GitHubReadError
from agent_builder_agent.tools.git_write_tools import DisabledGitWriteTools, GitWriteTools, WriteResult


def build_agent() -> Agent:
    return Agent(
        name="AgentBuilderAgentV1_2",
        instructions=(
            "You are AgentBuilderAgent v1.2. You generate PullRequestProposal(JSON) or AgentBuilderError(JSON). "
            "Read tools may be used only when ToolGate allows. Limited write tools (create_branch/create_pull_request) "
            "may be executed only when external humanApproved=true AND ToolGate allows. No merge/apply/deploy."
        ),
        tools=[],
    )


ParseSpecFn = Callable[[str, Optional[str], Optional[dict[str, Any]]], dict[str, Any]]
NormalizeSpecFn = Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any]
InferStepsFn = Callable[..., Awaitable[list[str]]]
GenerateSkeletonFn = Callable[..., Awaitable[Any]]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentDeps:
    parse_spec: ParseSpecFn = _parse_spec
    normalize_spec: NormalizeSpecFn = _normalize_spec
    infer_steps_if_missing: InferStepsFn = _infer_steps_if_missing
    generate_skeleton: GenerateSkeletonFn = _generate_skeleton


_HIGH_RISK_PREFIXES = (
    "infra/",
    "ops/",
    ".github/",
    "templates/",
    "security/",
    "billing/",
)


def _paths_from_proposal_dict(proposal_dict: dict) -> list[str]:
    # PullRequestProposalV0 is serialized; this must be defensive.
    changes = proposal_dict.get("changes") or {}
    files = changes.get("files") or []
    out: list[str] = []
    for f in files:
        if isinstance(f, dict):
            p = str(f.get("path", "")).strip()
            if p:
                out.append(p)
    return out


def _has_high_risk_path(paths: list[str]) -> bool:
    for p in paths:
        for pref in _HIGH_RISK_PREFIXES:
            if p.startswith(pref):
                return True
    return False


class AgentBuilderAgentV1_2:
    def __init__(
        self,
        router: LLMRouterClient,
        toolgate: ToolGateClient,
        github: GitHubReadClient,
        write_tools: Optional[GitWriteTools] = None,
        deps: Optional[AgentDeps] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._router = router
        self._toolgate = toolgate
        self._github = github
        self._write_tools = write_tools or DisabledGitWriteTools()
        self._deps = deps or AgentDeps()

    @staticmethod
    def _router_from_env() -> LLMRouterClient:
        base_url = os.environ.get("LLM_ROUTER_URL", "").strip()
        if not base_url:
            raise RuntimeError("LLM_ROUTER_URL is required.")
        api_key = os.environ.get("LLM_ROUTER_API_KEY")
        return LLMRouterClient(LLMRouterConfig(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key))

    @staticmethod
    def _toolgate_from_env() -> ToolGateClient:
        base_url = os.environ.get("TOOLGATE_URL", "").strip()
        if not base_url:
            raise RuntimeError("TOOLGATE_URL is required for tool permission checks.")
        api_key = os.environ.get("TOOLGATE_API_KEY")
        return ToolGateClient(ToolGateConfig(base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key))

    @staticmethod
    def _github_from_env() -> GitHubReadClient:
        token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
        base_url = os.environ.get("GITHUB_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.github.com")
        return GitHubReadClient(GitHubReadConfig(base_url=base_url, token=token))

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "AgentBuilderAgentV1_2":
        # write tools remain disabled by default in v1.2 unless explicitly wired.
        return cls(
            router=cls._router_from_env(),
            toolgate=cls._toolgate_from_env(),
            github=cls._github_from_env(),
            write_tools=None,
            deps=None,
        )

    async def _maybe_github_facts(
        self,
        req: AgentBuilderRequestV0,
        name_hint: str,
        risk_level: str,
        high_risk_detected: bool,
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], str]:
        decision_line = "github_read:not-requested"
        if req.githubReadMode == "off" or req.github is None:
            return [], [], decision_line

        try:
            d = await self._toolgate.evaluate(
                policy_version=req.toolPolicyVersion or "toolgate_v1",
                request_id=req.requestId,
                proposal_id=None,
                tool="github_read",
                effect="read",
                context={
                    "humanApproved": bool(getattr(req, "humanApproved", False)),
                    "riskLevel": risk_level,
                    "highRiskDetected": bool(high_risk_detected),
                    "pathsTouched": [],
                    "filesTouchedCount": 0,
                    "domains": ["agent"],
                },
            )
            decision_line = f"github_read:{d.decision}:{d.reason}"
        except (ToolGateError, Exception) as e:
            decision_line = f"github_read:deny:toolgate_error:{e}"
            return ["GitHub Facts:", "- github_read: deny (toolgate_error)"], [], decision_line

        if d.decision != "allow":
            return ["GitHub Facts:", f"- github_read: deny {d.reason}"], [], decision_line

        repo = req.github.repo
        base_ref = req.github.baseRef or req.repoContext.baseBranch

        notes: list[str] = []
        manual: list[str] = []
        overlap: list[str] = []
        failures: list[str] = []

        try:
            prs = await self._github.list_open_prs(repo)
            overlap = summarize_open_prs(prs, name_hint=name_hint)
        except GitHubReadError as e:
            notes.append(f"Failed to list open PRs: {e}")

        if req.githubReadMode == "metadata+ci":
            try:
                runs = await self._github.list_check_runs(repo, ref=base_ref)
                failures = summarize_ci_failures(runs)
                if failures:
                    manual.append("Reproduce or confirm recent CI failures before applying this proposal.")
            except GitHubReadError as e:
                notes.append(f"Failed to read check-runs: {e}")

        if overlap:
            manual.append("Potential overlap PR(s) detected; confirm consolidation/duplication strategy.")

        section = format_github_facts_section(GitHubFacts(overlap_prs=overlap, ci_failures=failures, notes=notes))
        return section.splitlines(), manual, decision_line

    async def _maybe_execute_write(
        self,
        req: AgentBuilderRequestV0,
        proposal_dict: dict,
        risk_level: str,
        high_risk_detected: bool,
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
        """Optionally executes limited write tools (v1.2), fully gated.

        Returns:
          - summary lines to append
          - manual steps to append

        Rules:
        - If constraints.proposalOnly == True: never execute
        - If humanApproved == False: never execute
        - ToolGate must allow for each tool call
        - Deny => no-call
        - Forbidden operations (merge/rebase/etc.) are not present in this method.
        """

        out_lines: list[str] = []
        manual: list[str] = []

        # Hard stops (v1.2 design)
        if bool(req.constraints.proposalOnly):
            out_lines.append("Write phase: skipped (proposalOnly=true)")
            return out_lines, manual

        if not bool(getattr(req, "humanApproved", False)):
            out_lines.append("Write phase: skipped (humanApproved=false)")
            manual.append("If you want to execute write tools, re-run with external humanApproved=true.")
            return out_lines, manual

        paths = _paths_from_proposal_dict(proposal_dict)
        files_touched_count = len(paths)

        # Defensive: if high-risk path is present, do not attempt write, even before ToolGate.
        if _has_high_risk_path(paths) or bool(high_risk_detected):
            out_lines.append("Write phase: skipped (high-risk detected)")
            manual.append("High-risk detected; do not execute write tools. Resolve risk and re-run.")
            return out_lines, manual

        # v1.2 assumes github context for repo ops.
        if req.github is None:
            out_lines.append("Write phase: skipped (github context missing)")
            manual.append("Provide github context (owner/repo) to enable write tools.")
            return out_lines, manual

        repo = req.github.repo
        base = req.github.baseRef or req.repoContext.baseBranch
        branch = f"agentbuilder/{req.requestId}"  # deterministic, reviewable

        # ToolGate context used for write tools
        tg_context = {
            "humanApproved": True,
            "riskLevel": risk_level,
            "highRiskDetected": False,
            "pathsTouched": paths,
            "filesTouchedCount": files_touched_count,
            "domains": ["agent"],
        }

        # create_branch
        try:
            d1 = await self._toolgate.evaluate(
                policy_version=req.toolPolicyVersion or "toolgate_v1",
                request_id=req.requestId,
                proposal_id=proposal_dict.get("proposalId"),
                tool="create_branch",
                effect="write",
                context=tg_context,
            )
            out_lines.append(f"ToolGate decisions: create_branch:{d1.decision}:{d1.reason}")
        except (ToolGateError, Exception) as e:
            out_lines.append(f"ToolGate decisions: create_branch:deny:toolgate_error:{e}")
            return out_lines, manual

        if d1.decision != "allow":
            out_lines.append("Write phase: create_branch not executed (deny)")
            return out_lines, manual

        # Execute create_branch
        br_res: WriteResult
        try:
            br_res = await self._write_tools.create_branch(repo=repo, base=base, branch=branch)
            out_lines.append(f"Write result: create_branch ok={br_res.ok} msg={br_res.message}")
        except Exception as e:
            out_lines.append(f"Write result: create_branch ok=false msg={e}")
            manual.append("Write tool failed (create_branch). Investigate and re-run.")
            return out_lines, manual

        if not br_res.ok:
            manual.append("Write tool returned failure for create_branch. Investigate before proceeding.")
            return out_lines, manual

        # create_pull_request
        try:
            d2 = await self._toolgate.evaluate(
                policy_version=req.toolPolicyVersion or "toolgate_v1",
                request_id=req.requestId,
                proposal_id=proposal_dict.get("proposalId"),
                tool="create_pull_request",
                effect="write",
                context=tg_context,
            )
            out_lines.append(f"ToolGate decisions: create_pull_request:{d2.decision}:{d2.reason}")
        except (ToolGateError, Exception) as e:
            out_lines.append(f"ToolGate decisions: create_pull_request:deny:toolgate_error:{e}")
            return out_lines, manual

        if d2.decision != "allow":
            out_lines.append("Write phase: create_pull_request not executed (deny)")
            return out_lines, manual

        # Execute create_pull_request
        try:
            pr_title = proposal_dict.get("title") or "AgentBuilder proposal"
            pr_body = proposal_dict.get("summary") or ""
            pr_res = await self._write_tools.create_pull_request(
                repo=repo,
                base=str(base),
                head=str(branch),
                title=str(pr_title),
                body=str(pr_body),
            )
            out_lines.append(f"Write result: create_pull_request ok={pr_res.ok} msg={pr_res.message}")
            if pr_res.url:
                out_lines.append(f"Write result: pr_url={pr_res.url}")
        except Exception as e:
            out_lines.append(f"Write result: create_pull_request ok=false msg={e}")
            manual.append("Write tool failed (create_pull_request). Investigate and re-run.")

        return out_lines, manual

    async def build_proposal(self, request_json: dict) -> dict:
        request_id = str(request_json.get("requestId", "unknown"))
        try:
            req = AgentBuilderRequestV0.model_validate(request_json)
        except Exception as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=request_id,
                code="SPEC_VALIDATION_FAILED",
                message="Request validation failed.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        if req.validationMode != "none":
            r = schema_validate_request_v0(request_json)
            if not r.ok:
                return error_response(
                    request_id=req.requestId,
                    code="SPEC_VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    message="Schema validation failed for AgentBuilderRequestV0.",
                    details=r.errors,
                )

        spec_text, spec_obj = req.get_spec_payload()
        try:
            raw = self._deps.parse_spec(req.specFormat, spec_text, spec_obj)
            parsed = self._deps.normalize_spec(raw)
        except SpecParseError as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=req.requestId,
                code="SPEC_PARSE_FAILED",
                message="Failed to parse spec.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        risk = detect_high_risk(parsed.raw)
        risk_level = "high" if risk.high_risk_detected else "low"

        snapshot = snapshot_from_existing_tree(req.repoContext.existingTree)
        hints = derive_structure_hints(snapshot)

        gh_lines: list[str] = []
        gh_manual: list[str] = []
        gh_decision_line = "github_read:not-requested"
        try:
            gh_lines, gh_manual, gh_decision_line = await self._maybe_github_facts(
                req,
                name_hint=parsed.name,
                risk_level=risk_level,
                high_risk_detected=risk.high_risk_detected,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            gh_lines = ["GitHub Facts:", f"- github_read: unavailable ({e})"]
            gh_manual = []
            gh_decision_line = f"github_read:deny:internal_error:{e}"

        try:
            steps = await self._deps.infer_steps_if_missing(
                router=self._router,
                routing_profile=req.routingProfile,
                name=parsed.name,
                purpose=parsed.purpose,
                raw_spec=parsed.raw,
                existing_steps=parsed.steps,
            )
        except (LLMRouterError, Exception):
            steps = ["Define project structure", "Generate core modules", "Add minimal README"]

        try:
            sk = await self._deps.generate_skeleton(
                router=self._router,
                routing_profile=req.routingProfile,
                target=req.target.model_dump(mode="json"),
                spec=parsed.raw,
                steps=steps,
                structure_hints=hints,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            return error_response(
                request_id=req.requestId,
                code="INTERNAL_ERROR",
                message="Failed to generate skeleton.",
                details=[str(e)],
            )

        title = f"Scaffold {parsed.name} skeleton (proposal-only, v1.2)"

        summary_lines = [
            f"Generates a minimal skeleton for '{parsed.name}' based on the provided spec.",
            "v1.2 supports limited write tools (create_branch/create_pull_request) gated by external humanApproved and ToolGate.",
            "",
            f"Purpose: {parsed.purpose}",
            "",
            "ToolGate decisions:",
            f"- {gh_decision_line}",
        ]

        if gh_lines:
            summary_lines += ["", *gh_lines]

        if risk.high_risk_detected:
            summary_lines += [
                "",
                "High-risk signals detected: proposal continues, but high-risk files are omitted.",
            ]

        files = [(f.path, f.content_type, f.content) for f in sk.files]
        proposal = build_pull_request_proposal(
            request_id=req.requestId,
            router_profile=req.routingProfile,
            title=title,
            summary="\n".join(summary_lines),
            risk=risk,
            directories=sk.directories,
            files=files,
            dependencies=[],
        )

        # GitHub-derived manual steps
        if gh_manual:
            try:
                proposal.validation.manualSteps.extend(gh_manual)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # v1.2 optional write phase (executed only when constraints.proposalOnly=false)
        # Serialize proposal first, then compute pathsTouched/filesTouchedCount from it.
        proposal_dict = proposal.model_dump(mode="json")
        try:
            w_lines, w_manual = await self._maybe_execute_write(
                req,
                proposal_dict=proposal_dict,
                risk_level=risk_level,
                high_risk_detected=risk.high_risk_detected,
            )
            if w_lines:
                proposal_dict["summary"] = (proposal_dict.get("summary") or "") + "\n\n" + "\n".join(w_lines)
            if w_manual:
                v = proposal_dict.get("validation") or {}
                ms = v.get("manualSteps") or []
                ms.extend(w_manual)
                v["manualSteps"] = ms
                proposal_dict["validation"] = v
        except Exception as e:
            proposal_dict["summary"] = (proposal_dict.get("summary") or "") + f"\n\nWrite phase: error ({e})"

        if req.validationMode != "none":
            pv = schema_validate_proposal_v0(proposal_dict)
            if not pv.ok:
                return error_response(
                    request_id=req.requestId,
                    code="INTERNAL_ERROR",
                    message="Schema validation failed for PullRequestProposalV0.",
                    details=pv.errors,
                )

        return proposal_dict

import asyncio

from agent_builder_agent.agent import AgentBuilderAgentV1_2


class _Decision:
    def __init__(self, decision: str, reason: str = "ok"):
        self.decision = decision
        self.reason = reason


class _ToolGateStub:
    def __init__(self, decisions):
        # decisions: dict[(tool,effect)] -> (decision,reason)
        self.decisions = decisions
        self.calls = []

    async def evaluate(self, *, policy_version, request_id, proposal_id, tool, effect, context):
        self.calls.append({"tool": tool, "effect": effect, "context": context})
        d, r = self.decisions.get((tool, effect), ("deny", "default-deny"))
        return _Decision(d, r)


class _WriteToolsStub:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    async def create_branch(self, *, repo: str, base: str, branch: str):
        self.calls.append(("create_branch", repo, base, branch))
        class _R:
            ok = True
            message = "branch created"
            ref = branch
            url = None
        return _R()

    async def create_pull_request(self, *, repo: str, base: str, head: str, title: str, body: str):
        self.calls.append(("create_pull_request", repo, base, head, title))
        class _R:
            ok = True
            message = "pr created"
            ref = None
            url = "https://example/pr/1"
        return _R()


class _RouterStub:
    pass


class _GitHubStub:
    pass


def _mk_req(*, humanApproved: bool, proposalOnly: bool, github: bool = True):
    req = {
        "requestId": "req_12345678",
        "specFormat": "json",
        "specObject": {"name": "Example", "purpose": "Test"},
        "target": {"repoKind": "single", "language": "python", "framework": "agents-sdk", "runtime": "python311"},
        "routingProfile": "codegen_standard",
        "repoContext": {"baseBranch": "main", "existingTree": []},
        "constraints": {"highRiskDomains": ["infra", "security", "billing", "template"], "disallowNetwork": True, "proposalOnly": proposalOnly},
        "validationMode": "none",
        "toolPolicyVersion": "toolgate_v1",
        "humanApproved": humanApproved,
        "githubReadMode": "off",
    }
    if github:
        req["github"] = {"repo": "owner/repo", "baseRef": "main"}
    return req


def _mk_proposal_dict(paths):
    return {
        "proposalId": "prp_x",
        "title": "t",
        "summary": "s",
        "changes": {"files": [{"path": p} for p in paths]},
        "validation": {"manualSteps": []},
    }


def test_s7_human_not_approved_no_call():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({("create_branch", "write"): ("deny", "human gate required")})
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()
    agent = AgentBuilderAgentV1_2(router=_RouterStub(), toolgate=tg, github=_GitHubStub(), write_tools=wt)

    req = _mk_req(humanApproved=False, proposalOnly=False)
    proposal = _mk_proposal_dict(["src/a.py", "src/b.py"])

    lines, manual = asyncio.run(agent._maybe_execute_write(req=type("R", (), req)(), proposal_dict=proposal, risk_level="low", high_risk_detected=False))

    assert any("humanApproved=false" in x for x in lines)
    assert wt.calls == []


def test_s6_human_approved_allow_calls_tools():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({
        ("create_branch", "write"): ("allow", "ok"),
        ("create_pull_request", "write"): ("allow", "ok"),
    })
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()
    agent = AgentBuilderAgentV1_2(router=_RouterStub(), toolgate=tg, github=_GitHubStub(), write_tools=wt)

    req = _mk_req(humanApproved=True, proposalOnly=False)
    proposal = _mk_proposal_dict(["src/a.py", "src/b.py"])

    lines, manual = asyncio.run(agent._maybe_execute_write(req=type("R", (), req)(), proposal_dict=proposal, risk_level="low", high_risk_detected=False))

    assert any("create_branch:allow" in x for x in lines)
    assert any("create_pull_request:allow" in x for x in lines)
    assert any(c[0] == "create_branch" for c in wt.calls)
    assert any(c[0] == "create_pull_request" for c in wt.calls)
    assert manual == []


def test_proposal_only_skips_write():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({("create_branch", "write"): ("allow", "ok")})
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()
    agent = AgentBuilderAgentV1_2(router=_RouterStub(), toolgate=tg, github=_GitHubStub(), write_tools=wt)

    req = _mk_req(humanApproved=True, proposalOnly=True)
    proposal = _mk_proposal_dict(["src/a.py"])

    lines, manual = asyncio.run(agent._maybe_execute_write(req=type("R", (), req)(), proposal_dict=proposal, risk_level="low", high_risk_detected=False))
